deviations.justification: The BV_AVAILABLE prose that issued `bv --robot-insights` for graph details is deleted (TRD-030); beads-build declares only work-graph.plan as optional (no graph-health).

No workflow.* capability stages files (plain-git workflow.commit is `git commit -m` only), so the source now states the staging intent ("stage exactly that path") without a literal `git add`; the agent still stages the same explicit paths before workflow.commit.
The final-progress `bv --robot-triage --format toon` call is replaced by work-graph.ready (default template `bv --robot-plan`); the work-graph contract has no triage capability.

`az repos pr create` was the Azure DevOps branch of the PR-creation backend switch; the default host adapter is `github` (toolchain.default.yaml), so the unconfigured sequence opens the change request with `gh pr create` only; the ADO step now lives in the azure-devops adapter behind host.change-request-create.

`br ready` was the fallback scheduler when bv is absent; scheduling is now work-graph.ready/work-graph.plan whose default adapter template is `bv --robot-plan` (the beads manifest declares no `br ready`) with a built-in links fallback, so `br ready` is no longer a default-toolchain step.

Two first-mention moves with no step added/removed: (1) the first pre-refactor `br list` was the br availability probe, deleted in favor of preflight; (2) the pre-refactor `bv --robot-plan` first appeared in the description of the wave-runner (scheduling is delegated to beads-build-wave in both versions), while the refactor invokes work-graph.ready (same `bv --robot-plan` template) once, in the final progress step, replacing the `bv --robot-triage` summary.
